selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before restart (boot id + current sysctl state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id d9f8550d... and pre-change sysctl values showing accept_redirects/secure_redirects=1 on node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
selected_evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl --system, and after discovering per-interface OR-semantics issue, extended config with explicit enp1s0/lo overrides; verified all/default/enp1s0/lo values are 0 for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id and dispatched a backgrounded sudo systemctl reboot; command returned 'reboot command dispatched' before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Poll node1 until command execution available again, proving changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Polling attempts failed with connection timeout/reset while node1 was rebooting, then succeeded with a new boot_id 1c9de043-fbc0-444a-b00d-a9e41504fbcd, differing from the baseline d9f8550d..., proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the hardening settings (persistence proof)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl and /proc/sys checks confirm accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route are still 0 for all/default/enp1s0/lo, and the persisted config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf is unchanged and present

commands.command:

echo "== boot id baseline =="

echo "== current sysctl values (pre-change) =="

  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route \

net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0

net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0

cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "== applying =="

  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route

echo "== verifying per-existing-interface values =="
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== extending persistent config with existing interfaces =="
IFACES=$(ls -1 /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf | grep -vE '^(all|default)$')
{
  echo ""
  echo "# Explicit per-interface overrides (existing interfaces already initialized at boot)"
  for i in $IFACES; do
    echo "net.ipv4.conf.${i}.accept_redirects = 0"
    echo "net.ipv4.conf.${i}.secure_redirects = 0"
    echo "net.ipv4.conf.${i}.accept_source_route = 0"
  done
} | sudo -n tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf > /dev/null

cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "== re-applying =="
sudo -n sysctl --system > /tmp/sysctl-apply.log 2>&1
tail -20 /tmp/sysctl-apply.log

echo "== verifying per-interface live values =="
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/secure_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done
for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done
